question: What is the female mortality rate of the state with the highest male mortality rate (the rightmost point, about 50 per 100,000)? (A) about 28 per 100k (B) about 35 per 100k (C) about 20 per 100k. Answer with just the letter.
description: MT attack on the public_health scatter chart. The y-axis uses a log scale for linear data. Misleader from Lo et al., 'Misinformed by Visualization' (EuroVis 2022): inappropriate log scale. True answer: A (about 28 per 100k). Bait: C (about 20 per 100k).
